text:
Alex: hey team — quick q :wave: I’ve got 4 unused PTO days from this year. Manager said it’s fine to carry over but I remember there was a rule about submitting something formal. Do I need to submit a request in the portal or is a manager Slack ok? Also — our team has a mini shutdown Jan 2-4, does that count as blackout for carryover?

Morgan (People Ops): hi Alex — short answer: you need a formal request in Workday for carryover. Manager verbal ok as proofofapproval, but we need the request + manager approval recorded. Blackout vs shutdown are slightly different — company shutdown (official) is separate: you can’t use carryover to extend the shutdown days beyond what payroll allows.

Alex: ok what’s the exact workflow? submit in Workday and then manager approves there?

Morgan (People Ops): correct — steps: 1) create a PTO request and select reason = "Carryover"; 2) in the comments add manager name and date they approved; 3) manager approves in Workday. If it’s an exception (over 5 days, or into the next fiscal year) cc @People Ops so we can sign off. Payroll cutoff for carryover processing is Dec 20 this year — requests after that will be queued for manual processing in January.

people_ops_bot: Reminder: Payroll cutoff for PTO carryover is Dec 20 23:59 UTC. Submit requests before cutoff to avoid manual handling. <https://hr.example.com/carryover-guidelines|Carryover guidelines>

Jess: quick follow-up — I’m part-time (0.6 FTE). How does pro-rata carryover work?

Morgan (People Ops): part-time employees accrue pro-rata. When you submit the carryover request, Workday will show your available balance; if you think it’s wrong, attach a screenshot of your balance and tag us. We’ll verify and adjust. If you’re under a local leave law (e.g., CA) there are additional protections — tell us and we’ll route to payroll compliance.

Samir: one edge case — I’m going on LOA starting Dec 15 and returning Feb 1. Can I carry over days while on LOA?

Morgan (People Ops): LOA rules vary by LOA type. For short unpaid LOA we usually allow carryover but you must submit before LOA start; for medical or parental LOA we have a different flows. Please open a case via the HR portal and select "LOA + Carryover" and include your LOA dates. We’ll handle the exception if needed.

Alex: perfect, thanks. I’ll file today and paste the Workday request here when done. :white_check_mark: 

Jess: thanks — cc'ing my manager so they can approve quick.
